body:
## Summary of the Pull Request

Bounds the GitHub Copilot ACP permission compatibility block to CLI versions 1.0.81-1 through 1.0.83-3. Version 1.0.83-4 and later now use the normal Yolo-off prompt path, while affected and unparseable versions remain fail closed.

## References and Relevant Issues

github/copilot-cli#4537

## Detailed Description of the Pull Request / Additional comments

Direct ACP denied-permission probes identified 1.0.83-4 as the first safe release.

## Validation Steps Performed

Added boundary and prompt-dispatch regressions. Focused tests pass. Full explicit-target WTA: 2,009 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. Pinned official Copilot binaries showed 1.0.83-3 executing without a permission request and 1.0.83-4 requesting permission; cancelled requests produced no file side effect.
